record.paper_title: Conferences WORDS, years 1997-2017: Open Problems and Conjectures
record.original_question: Kirby Baker, Georges F. McNulty and Walter Taylor have shown that the pattern abXbcYcaZbaTac is 4-avoidable, but not 3- avoidable [8]. What is the minimal proportion of the fourth letter needed to avoid that pattern?

evidence.quote: Kirby Baker, Georges F. McNulty and Walter Taylor have shown that the pattern abXbcYcaZbaTac is 4-avoidable, but not 3- avoidable [8]. What is the minimal proportion of the fourth letter needed to avoid that pattern?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Sigma_k=\{0,1,\dots,k-1\}$ be a finite alphabet. A pattern is a word $p$ over an alphabet of variables. An infinite word $w\in\Sigma_k^{\mathbb N}$ is said to encounter $p$ if there exists a non-erasing morphism $h$ from the variable alphabet to $\Sigma_k^{+}$ such that $h(p)$ is a factor of $w$; otherwise $w$ avoids $p$. The pattern $p$ is $k$-avoidable if there exists an infinite word over $\Sigma_k$ avoiding $p$.

Consider the pattern 
$$p \;=\; ab\,X\,bc\,Y\,ca\,Z\,ba\,T\,ac,$$
on the variable alphabet $\{a,b,c,X,Y,Z,T\}$. It is known that $p$ is $4$-avoidable but not $3$-avoidable.

For an infinite word $w$ over $\Sigma_4=\{0,1,2,3\}$, let
$$\mathrm{freq}_w(\alpha) \;=\; \liminf_{n\to\infty}\frac{|w[1..n]|_{\alpha}}{n}$$
denote the (lower) frequency of letter $\alpha$ in $w$.

Determine the value of
$$\mu \;=\; \inf\Bigl\{\,\max_{\alpha\in\Sigma_4}\bigl(1 - 3\,\mathrm{freq}_w(\alpha)\bigr)\,\Bigr\}^{-1}\quad\text{(equivalently)}$$
$$\mu \;=\; \inf_{w}\;\min_{\alpha\in\Sigma_4}\mathrm{freq}_w(\alpha),$$
where the infimum is taken over all infinite words $w\in\Sigma_4^{\mathbb N}$ that avoid the pattern $p$. In other words, what is the minimal possible asymptotic proportion of the least-frequent (fourth) letter in an infinite $4$-letter word avoiding $ab\,X\,bc\,Y\,ca\,Z\,ba\,T\,ac$?
artifact.status_search_result: Searches in the combinatorics-on-words literature (Ochem and collaborators, palindrome/pattern-avoidance surveys, HDOL constructions) did not yield a published value of the minimal frequency of the fourth letter in infinite 4-letter words avoiding the pattern abXbcYcaZbaTac. The question, originally raised by Baker, McNulty and Taylor and reposed in the WORDS open-problems compilation, appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Pattern Avoidance and HDOL Words (Ochem)
status_evidence.snippet: Slides on pattern avoidance methods using HDOL words; no resolution of the minimal frequency for the Baker–McNulty–Taylor pattern is given.
status_evidence.claim: No solution to the minimal-frequency question is reported in the surveyed pattern-avoidance literature.

status_evidence.title: Avoidability of palindrome patterns (Ochem)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey-style paper addressing avoidability of various patterns; the specific minimal letter-frequency question for abXbcYcaZbaTac is not resolved here.
status_evidence.claim: Recent pattern-avoidance work does not contain the answer.

status_evidence.title: Dejean's conjecture and letter frequency
status_evidence.snippet: Work on extremal letter frequencies in pattern-avoiding words, related methodology but not addressing this specific pattern.
status_evidence.claim: Methods exist for analogous frequency questions but the specific value remains unresolved in available sources.
